description: Illustrative corridor project finance screen using supplied financial figures and internal DSCR/leverage thresholds. Mandatory human review; no lender approval, current hydrological verification, or guarantee of financing. Missing financial data is rejected. Required tool arguments: project_name, corridor_leg, capex_usd_m, ifi_debt_usd_m, dscr_min. Follow inputSchema; this tool does not require a prior evidence packet unless the schema asks for one. Illustrative example arguments (synthetic; replace with your own data): {"project_name":"Synthetic Aktau project","corridor_leg":"Aktau-Baku","capex_usd_m":100,"ifi_debt_usd_m":60,"dscr_min":1.3}. Evaluation requires a signed Base USDC payment for the exact request, or Pro access. Discovery is free. Keep the original request and X-Payment-Signature for result recovery within 24 hours. Current prices: https://agenda-intelligence-a2a.vassiliy-lakhonin.workers.dev/.well-known/x402. Do not pay automatically. Evidence triage only: no factual-truth verification, no legal, compliance, sanctions, or financial advice. Human review is required before any commercial action.

capex_usd_m.description: Total project capital expenditure in millions USD.

currency_mismatch.description: Whether tariff revenues are collected in local currency (KZT/AZN/GEL) while debt is in USD/EUR.

dscr_min.description: Projected minimum Debt Service Coverage Ratio (DSCR).

evidence_sources.description: List of feasibility study references, decrees, or project files.

has_sovereign_guarantee.description: Whether an official sovereign loan guarantee is provided.

ifi_debt_usd_m.description: Target IFI senior debt financing in millions USD.

project_name.description: Name of the corridor infrastructure project (e.g. 'Aktau Port Container Hub Expansion').
